title: Textarea
description: Multi-line text field on react-aria TextField + TextArea, on the same extruded material and states as Input, with a vertical resize handle and a minimum height set by rows. Label, description and error come from Field.

anatomy.description: react-aria TextField root with data-slot="textarea" and data-size; carries data-invalid, data-disabled and data-required from react-aria. Owns the label-above stack.
The shared Field parts, associated by react-aria; the error renders only while isInvalid.

The react-aria TextArea: bark-50 fill, faint hairline, --lift-highlight up-left and --lift-shade down-right; bloom hairline on hover and focus; inset while focused; heartwood hairline while invalid; vertical resize only.

usage: Always pass label. Use labelVariant="title" when the field heads its own card (the SCOUT report's dimension notes); the default caption is the uppercase form label.
rows sets the visible lines (default 3); the box grows by the user's drag, never by content, so a long note does not reflow the page.
Use react-aria semantics: value and onChange (the string, not an event), isRequired, isInvalid, isDisabled and name pass straight through to TextField.
Same recipe as Input: extruded at rest, inset while focused, bloom on hover and focus, heartwood while invalid. Change one, change both.
Disabled removes the resize handle along with the pointer.
